beats.event: Impoverished ex-student obsesses over murdering a pawnbroker
Meets drunk Marmeladov; learns of his daughter Sonya
Letter describes sister Dunya's plight with Luzhin
Steals axe; kills pawnbroker Alyona and her sister Lizaveta
Falls into fever and delirium
Faints when police mention the murders
Laborer Mikolka takes the blame, diverting suspicion
Helps the dying Marmeladov in the street
Mother and sister arrive in Petersburg
Porfiry probes him about the 'extraordinary man' article
Svidrigailov appears suddenly at his room
Dunya breaks her engagement with Luzhin
Raskolnikov confesses the murders to Sonya
Luzhin frames Sonya for theft; Lebezyatnikov exposes him
Katerina Ivanovna unravels and dies
Porfiry declares certainty of his guilt, urges confession
Svidrigailov tries to coerce Dunya; she shoots at him
Svidrigailov commits suicide
Raskolnikov confesses to police after seeing Sonya's despair
Eight years in Siberia; Sonya follows; redemption begins
